correctness.rationale: On M_(2n)=C_(2n)(1,n), n>=4, cubic first-force obstruction shows Z>=4. Two initial three-blue patterns and their possible fourth supporting seed yield five dihedral orbits of sizes 2n,4n,4n,2n,n; the local arrival-time equation yields their n-parity times and exact three-term generating polynomial. Independently implemented direct synchronous forcing over every four-subset for n=4..10 and reproduced all distributions (even m: n,8n,4n at m-1,m,m+1; odd m:3n,6n,4n at m,m+1,m+2). Source verification programs verify_a.py and verify_b.cpp were inspected, not treated as infinite proofs. Boundary n=3 excluded.
